subject.title: [Feature Request] Make command options clickable buttons in Feishu (e.g., /reasoning)

question: Should no-argument command status replies like `/reasoning` emit shared typed command-action presentation for Feishu and other capable channels, or should Feishu get a channel-specific card path?
rationale: Both paths can produce clickable Feishu buttons, but repository policy favors typed presentation actions over transport-specific string inference, and changing command-status replies affects shared command UX beyond one Feishu formatter.

options.title: Use shared typed presentation
options.body: Emit command-status options as portable `action.type: "command"` buttons so Feishu and other capable channels render the same canonical command controls with text fallback.

options.title: Add Feishu-only cards
options.body: Keep the shared command-status reply text unchanged and add Feishu-specific cards for these commands, accepting a narrower but more duplicated channel path.

options.title: Leave status replies text-only
options.body: Keep `/reasoning` status output as plain text and close or defer this UX request until a broader command-presentation design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Use shared typed presentation
recommendation.body: Emit command-status options as portable `action.type: "command"` buttons so Feishu and other capable channels render the same canonical command controls with text fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the typed presentation command-action contract that best matches the repository boundary for this decision.
